label: For "Provider Enrollment Delay Prediction": Predict payer enrollment and roster delays that affect network participation, scheduling and reimbursement, and tell enrollment specialists the likely bottleneck and next best follow-up. Define the label exactly as in milestone M1: what counts as a positive or a correct outcome, and when it becomes known. Design around this trap first: Starting the clock before the file is complete.
